scientific_integrity: The strict interpolation, radial nesting and exact Hessian are proved under explicit hypotheses; a previously known perspective inequality is credited as an ingredient.
scientific_limitations: Requires \(n\ge2\), \(\beta>0\), \(C^3\) boundary and everywhere positive Gaussian curvature.
All admissible translations must keep the origin strictly inside the translated body.
Unique-maximizer existence for arbitrary nonsymmetric bodies is not asserted.
The Hessian coefficient is an exact integral; no general elementary closed form is claimed.
Numerical disk experiments supplement but do not establish the analytic theorem.
Historical novelty beyond inspected sources is not independently certified.
title: Strict Minkowski concavity and canonical centering of critical covariogram transition bodies
